# docker_container_logs (Data Source)

Reads a container's logs (`GET /containers/{id}/logs`), like `docker container logs --timestamps`. `log_entries` holds one object per line (`timestamp`, `stream`, `source`, `message`) and `logs` the same lines as text. Output of containers without a TTY is demultiplexed into `stdout` / `stderr` entries; a TTY container's lines have stream `combined`. The read does not follow the log and keeps the last `tail` lines (default 1000).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_container_logs" "web" {
  container = "web"
  tail      = 100
  since     = "15m"
  stderr    = true
}

# log_entries messages are sensitive: they can carry secrets the application printed.
output "web_errors" {
  value     = [for e in data.docker_container_logs.web.log_entries : "${e.timestamp} ${e.message}" if strcontains(e.message, "ERROR")]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) The container whose logs are read, by ID or name.

### Optional

- `details` (Boolean) Add the extra attributes the log driver records (for example labels) to each message (Engine `details`). Default `false`.
- `since` (String) Only lines at or after this time. Takes an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-02T15:04:05Z`) or a duration before now such as `42m` or `1h30m`, sent as the Engine's UNIX-timestamp `since`. Combined with `tail` when both are set.
- `stderr` (Boolean) Include standard error (Engine `stderr`). Default `true`.
- `stdout` (Boolean) Include standard output (Engine `stdout`). Default `true`.
- `tail` (Number) Lines to keep from the end of the logs of each container, service or task (the Engine's `tail`). Default `1000`, so state cannot grow without bound; `0` reads none, and there is no "all".
- `until` (String) Only lines before this time (Engine `until`): an RFC 3339 timestamp, a UNIX timestamp or a duration before now such as `10m`.

### Read-Only

- `container_id` (String) ID of the container the logs were read from.
- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of logs.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `id` (String) Container ID (the same value as `container_id`).
- `log_entries` (Attributes List) One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is the container name (without the leading "/"). Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_entries))
- `logs` (String, Sensitive) The log entries as plain text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>". Sensitive: log lines can print secrets.

<a id="nestedatt--log_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `log_entries`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `log line without the timestamp prefix and trailing newline`. Sensitive.
- `source` (String) Upstream `Name (leading "/" removed)`.
- `stream` (String) Upstream `multiplexed frame header stream type: 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr; a TTY stream is not multiplexed (the Engine merges stdout and stderr at the source), so it is "combined"`.
- `timestamp` (String) Upstream `timestamps=true line prefix (RFC 3339 nano)`.
